description: Put one confirmed term of a project on other sites (PM-1165, PM-1166): a link anybody can open with no account, which shows the term's word, its definition with its formulas and — while the project is public — where it is defined; nothing else of the project. Answers with the ready code: 'script' once per page and 'mark' around the words on the site, which open the term in a cloud, or 'iframe', a card. Name the term by 'id' (list_terms), or by 'project' and 'term' — its word or any spelling. 'sites' limits which sites may show it (https://example.org each; none is any); 'days' gives it a term (none is until removed). Only for somebody who may write in the project and open the term's source; a line in the project's history. For many terms of one article, create_embed_set gives one link for all of them.

days.description: Days the link answers, 1 to 3650. Optional: none is until it is removed.

id.description: The term's id, as list_terms returned it. Or name it by 'project' and 'term'.

sites.description: Sites that may show it, comma-separated, as https://example.org. Optional: none is any site.

term.description: The term's word or one of its spellings, with 'project'.

name: create_term_embed
title: Create term embed
